latestMilestone: The authenticated System Edition now ships verified first-party GTK4 foundations for SWIR Files, SWIR Settings, SWIR Notes and SWIR System Monitor. Notes uses bounded owner-only atomic per-user persistence, System Monitor provides bounded read-only /proc telemetry, all four applications map real GTK4 windows on Wayland, and the integration head passed graphical-session, Live USB install and full graphical-installer E2E. The complete native daily-use application suite and physical Live USB qualification remain open.
